title: Space charge with a surface-charged face (electrostatics, analytic)
description:
A dielectric slab (eps_r = 4, 1 mm along x, insulated y faces: 1D) filled with a uniform free charge rho0 (charge_density feature), grounded (voltage 0) on x_lo and carrying a surface charge sigma_s on x_hi (surface_charge feature, a Neumann condition D.n = sigma_s into the domain). The sweep runs sigma_s / (rho0 L) over -1, -0.75, 0 and -0.25.
Analytic: V = ((sigma_s + rho0 L) x - rho0 x^2 / 2) / eps, D_x = rho0 x - sigma_s - rho0 L, E_x = D_x / eps (eps = eps0 eps_r); maximum V_max = (sigma_s + rho0 L)^2 / (2 rho0 eps) at x = (sigma_s + rho0 L) / rho0 (3L/4 at the last value; 0 and L at -1 and 0); charge on the grounded plate Q = -(sigma_s + rho0 L) w (Gauss: the plate, the space charge and the face charge sum to 0).
Derived values tab: Q_plate (exact, Gauss), V_max (maximum cell value: exact here, the scheme's uniform offset rho0 dx^2 / (8 eps) cancels against the half-cell distance of the cell centres from the maximum, which lies on a cell edge or a face), V_end (probe in the last cell, x = L - dx/2: offset rho0 dx^2 / (8 eps), ~5e-5), D_mean (exact: the face fluxes are exact by charge conservation).
Sweep tab: V_end and Q_plate vs sigma_ratio with the dashed references (Q_plate_vs_ratio is drawn, not toleranced: its per-point relative error is undefined at the exact zero of sigma_ratio = -1; the derived Q_plate checks every value).
Line profile tab (last sweep value): V (parabola), E_x and D_x (straight lines through 0 at the maximum of V).

parameters.name: rho0
parameters.description: uniform free charge density in C/m^3

parameters.name: eps_slab
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of the slab

parameters.name: w_slab
parameters.description: slab height along y (insulated y faces: 1D)

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (100 cells along x)

parameters.name: sigma_ratio
parameters.description: surface charge in units of rho0 L (swept)

parameters.name: sigma_s
parameters.description: surface charge on x_hi in C/m^2

parameters.name: D_lo
parameters.description: minus D_x at the grounded face, C/m^2

parameters.name: x_peak
parameters.description: position of the maximum of V in [0, L]

parameters.name: V_max_ref
parameters.description: analytic maximum of V in V

parameters.name: x_end
parameters.description: probe position: centre of the last cell
